# Awesome Coding Plans

> A maintained, coding-focused comparison of AI subscriptions, token plans, coding agents, and student offers.

## Machine-readable catalog

- [plans.json](https://awesome-coding-plans.netlify.app/plans.json): complete plan catalog with type, price band, quota model, model access, tags, flags, and official links.
- [Comparison](https://awesome-coding-plans.netlify.app/comparison): curated side-by-side picks.
- [Student discounts](https://awesome-coding-plans.netlify.app/student-discounts): coding-related student offers.

## Source and freshness

The canonical source is the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/vaproh/awesome-coding-plans). Prices and availability can change; verify the official link on each plan page before purchasing.
